name: Rubyfront of the Pact
summary: The beast of the oath: it opens the deck to the Humans on top, puts them back on their feet and drives them forward.

nexusRequirement.label: Nexus requirement
nexusRequirement.text: Control at least 3 Human Entities and discard a Zero Matter card, during your Preparation Phase only

faceA.name: Rubyfront of the Pact

keyword.name: Fury
keyword.rules: d20 ≥ 12 before every action · failure −1 HP

effect.text: You look at the top card of your deck, and from that top you may play your Human Entities as if they were in your hand.

frontCommand.name: Front Command
frontCommand.text: untap up to 2 Human Entities you control and send them back into line.

swell.name: Swell
swell.text: all Human Entities you control get +1 Power until end of turn.

pactCall.name: Call of the Pact
pactCall.text: search your deck for a Human Entity costing 3 or less, reveal it to your opponent, take it into your hand and shuffle.

faceA.flavor: They did not swear to her. They swore with her.

faceB.name: Incarnation of the Pact

effect.text: You look at the top card of your deck, and from that top you may play your Human Entities as if they were in your hand.

frontOrder.name: Order of the Front
frontOrder.text: untap every Human Entity in your Front Zone, down to the last one.

greatTide.name: Great Tide
greatTide.text: your Entities get +1 Power until end of turn and no Entity of greater Power can block them.

faceB.flavor: The pact took flesh. No one remembers who signed it first.
